CustomField.description: This Checkbox is selected MANUALLY via Excelsior Users. When this checkbox is set to 'true' it bypasses the user email/sms process and uses the code from Portal_Verification_Code
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Please check this box when you want to manually bypass the Application Portal MFA for students. You will be asked to enter a 5 digit code in the field below.
CustomField.label: Portal Verification Override
